heading: INT. FIELD HOSPITAL - CONVERTED TRAIN CARRIAGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. FIELD HOSPITAL - CONVERTED TRAIN CARRIAGE - NIGHT
A passenger coach gutted for surgery.
Cots where seats were.
Hand-pumped lamps swing with the rails.
A plywood table bolted to the floor.
DR. ISADORA FONTAINE (40s, surgical cap, sleeves rolled) leans over a patient on the table.
NURSE KWABENA ASANTE (30s, steady hands) holds retractors.
ORDERLY SZYMON (19, sleeves too long) feeds a hand-crank fan.
A fourth figure, a SOLDIER in his twenties, lies still under the sheet with his boot half off.
Everyone, suction. Now.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: Kwabena and Szymon both lunge for the pump.
They collide, hands tangled on the handle.
Mine.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: Sorry. Sorry.
units.name: SZYMON

units.text: Come on. Come on, you stubborn thing.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: The train lurches on a curve.
Instruments slide.
Fontaine pins the tray with her forearm.
Kwabena catches a clamp mid-air.
Doctor, pressure is dropping.
units.name: KWABENA

units.text: I see it. Szymon, more light, left side.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: Which left?
units.name: SZYMON

units.text: Yours.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: He swings the lamp over.
The soldier on the table gasps and arches.
Everyone stills.
Don't cut my leg.
units.name: SOLDIER

units.text: We're not cutting your leg.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: Promise.
units.name: SOLDIER

units.text: I promise. What's your name?
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: Corporal. Corporal Adeyemi.
units.name: SOLDIER

units.text: Okay, Adeyemi. We're going to keep you.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: Mama, please.
units.name: ADEYEMI

units.text: Kwabena and Szymon exchange a look.
Szymon wipes his eyes on his sleeve.
The fan hums.
Last stitch. Hold the line. Everybody breathe out.
units.name: FONTAINE

units.text: The carriage exhales.
The train rattles over a bridge, and for one second all four of them are still, as if the whole world is balanced on a thread.
